name: page
title: Page
description: A panel page's frame: its width, gutters and the rhythm between the header and its sections.

when: Laying out a page of an admin or back-office app: a PageHeader, then sections of tables, forms or cards.
Keeping every page at the same width and spacing instead of setting widths and gaps per page.

instead.when: Full-width bands of a marketing or landing page.
Grouping fields inside a settings form (FormSection).

builtIn: A titled PageSection is a region named by its h2.
youProvide: One PageHeader (the page's h1) before the sections.

Page.name: width
Page.description:
The content's widest: `default` 1200px for most panel pages, `narrow` 800px for a form or settings page that
reads as one column, `full` for wide tables and boards. Always centred; gutters included.

PageSection.name: title
PageSection.description: The section's name, an h2 ("Active customers"); leave it out for a section the page header already names.

PageSection.name: actions
PageSection.description: At the header's end: a link to everything, a small button, a filter.
